camera.comment_device: 0 for /dev/video0, or use full path like /dev/video0
camera.comment_matrix: Camera calibration matrix - run camera_calibration.py to generate your own

yolo.comment: Set enabled to false if you only want AprilTag detection

apriltag.comment_tag_size: Size of AprilTag in meters (6.5 inches = 0.1651m for FRC tags)

target.comment: Approximate width of game piece for distance estimation

comment_priority: Options: 'yolo', 'apriltag', or 'both'. Use 'both' to detect either type

streaming.comment_port: Port for MJPEG stream (1181-1190 recommended for FRC)
streaming.comment_quality: JPEG quality 0-100 (higher = better quality, more bandwidth)

debug.comment: Set to false for headless operation on robot
